text: 财政部将于近期发行3000亿元特别国债，支持8家中央金融企业补充核心一级资本。 当日，工商银行、农业银行、进出口银行、中国信保、中国人保、中国人寿集团、中国太平、中国再保等8家中央金融企业分别发布了增资计划。 业内人士表示，此次财政部对8家中央金融企业增资，属于“未雨绸缪”的前瞻性安排，是支持中央金融企业高质量发展、助力宏观经济行稳致远的主动作为。（新华社）
text_en: The Ministry of Finance will soon issue 300 billion yuan in special treasury bonds to support 8 central state-owned financial enterprises in replenishing core Tier-1 capital. On the same day, ICBC, Agricultural Bank of China, Export-Import Bank of China, Sinosure, PICC, China Life Group, China Taiping, and China Re each announced capital increase plans. Industry insiders said this capital injection by the Ministry of Finance into 8 central financial enterprises is a forward-looking arrangement to 'prepare for rain before it comes,' representing proactive action to support high-quality development of central financial enterprises and steady long-term economic growth. (Xinhua)
